description: Energie uit oppervlaktewater (EOW) | Koude - Gemalen, Stuwen en diepe plassen (Dataset) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by warmteatlas.nl. Works of art Ground (and other works of art) can be provided with heat exchangers with which cold can be extracted from the water flow. This allows a very high cooling power to be generated with a small investment. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Energy from surface water (EOW) | Cold — Grounds, Struggles and Deep puddles (Dataset)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
